subject: SI practical labs delivery matrix and kickoff
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@elevate-consulting.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SI practical labs kickoff and delivery matrix

Hi Markus / Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Elevate team is excited to start technical enablement for our solution engineers. We want a set of hands-on, catalogue-style labs that our consultants can run end-to-end (from provisioning to deploying a simple Redwood-inference-backed feature) so they can accelerate client engagements.

Key asks: 
- A practical labs "matrix" that maps labs to outcomes, prerequisites, estimated time, and environment (hosted vs dedicated vs private).
- A recommended delivery cadence (self-paced + instructor-led options).
- Sandbox access and a checklist of prerequisites we should prep on our side.

Attached is a short requirements brief from our enablement lead. Can you propose a delivery matrix and a 2-3 week schedule for an initial cohort of 8 consultants? Timezone preference: PST.

We'd like to lock dates before the end of the month.

Cheers,
Sarah Nguyen
Head of Enablement | Elevate Consulting
Onboarding: onboarding@elevate-consulting.com

Attachment: elevate_requirements.pdf (1 page)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@elevate-consulting.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-16T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SI practical labs kickoff and delivery matrix

Hi Sarah — great to hear from you.

We've sketched a first-pass "practical labs delivery matrix" and an initial schedule for a cohort of eight. High level summary below; attached is the XLSX with lab-level estimates and outcome mappings.

Proposed labs (short labels):
- Lab 1: Quickstart + Hosted API integration (1.5h) — outcome: feature prototype with hosted API
- Lab 2: Dedicated capacity basics + throughput tuning (2h) — outcome: predictable latency under load
- Lab 3: Private deployment & VPC networking (3h) — outcome: air-gapped proof-of-concept
- Lab 4: Cost controls: batching, caching, quant profiles (1.5h) — outcome: unit-cost optimization checklist
- Lab 5: Observability + troubleshooting (1h) — outcome: SLO/trace exercises and alert runbooks
- Optional Lab 6: Model swap & fallback policies (1h) — outcome: resilience test

Delivery format options:
- Instructor-led (2 full days + 2 half-day follow-ups) — ideal for cohort ramp
- Self-paced guided labs + weekly office hours (4 weeks) — for timezone flexibility

Proposed timeline (PST):
Week 0: Prep & sandbox access (we'll provide a provisioning checklist)
Week 1 (Mon/Tue): Instructor-led core labs 1-3
Week 2 (Wed): Labs 4-5 + resilience lab 6 as stretch
Week 3: Office hours + capstone walkthroughs

Next steps I suggest:
1) Review attached matrix and confirm must-have labs.
2) Sarah shares preferred cohort start week and blackout dates.
3) We provision a dedicated sandbox project and invite your engineers (requires emails).

I've attached SI_Practical_Labs_Matrix_v1.xlsx — it has recommended prerequisites, expected learner outcomes, and per-lab wall-clock time (including setup).

Cc'ing Camila for environment/provisioning details and Stephanie for trainer availability.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Partner Engineering | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

Attachment: SI_Practical_Labs_Matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@elevate-consulting.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-16T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SI practical labs kickoff and delivery matrix

Quick operational notes from my side:
- Sandbox: we can spin up a single shared project per cohort with role-based accounts for each trainee. We'll document quotas and cleanup steps in the provisioning checklist.
- Environments: for Lab 3 (Private deployment), we'll provide a sample VPC template and an on-prem checklist. That lab will need a 3-hour block and one infra engineer from Elevate for the network setup step.
- Data: all labs can run with synthetic data; if you want to use a customer dataset we can add a data-handling sign-off task.

Ben — can you confirm estimated time to provision the shared sandbox (in PST) and whether we need any additional approvals?

Camila Reyes
Partner Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@elevate-consulting.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-16T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SI practical labs kickoff and delivery matrix

Happy to run the instructor-led sessions. My availability for late-April: 4/24, 4/25 (full days) and 5/2 (half day).

Trainer notes: I run the hands-on workshops with a mix of slides + live lab steps (I limit each lab to 6-10 participants to keep it practical). I attached a short trainer bio and sample agenda.

Proposed capstone: each pair of consultants will deliver a short demo integrating Redwood into a small feature (10 minutes) on the final day. We'll grade on deployment reproducibility and SLO verification.

Attachment: trainer_bio_stephanie.pdf

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Principal Training Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@elevate-consulting.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-16T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SI practical labs kickoff and delivery matrix

Thanks everyone — this looks great and very practical.

We confirm a cohort start of week-of-2028-04-24 (trainer availability aligns). A few quick items:
- Please send sandbox invite list format (we will provide emails).
- We prefer the instructor-led core on 4/24-4/25 and the capstone on 5/2.
- PO tracking: I'll share Purchase Order ELV-PO-3372 next week; can you confirm whether Redwood needs a separate SOW signature for the instructor-led delivery?

Camila — please include the provisioning checklist link in your next email.

Looking forward to the matrix file and the drive links you referenced.

Best,
Sarah
Head of Enablement | Elevate Consulting
